main.description: Add a member (by DID) or replace their read and write access on a memberspace space. Requires auth with a covering manage=update grant, implemented by PDS.

space.description: Permissioned space URI, in the form at://{authority}/space/{spaceType}/{skey}. Not a standard at-uri.

did.description: The DID of the account to add or update as a member.

read.description: Whether the member is authorized to read the space.

write.description: Whether the member's writes are tracked and forwarded by the space authority.
